programme.title: Европейские ценности
programme.desc: Что делать со старыми домами из советского прошлого заранее, чтобы они не начали рассыпаться, превратившись в угрозу? Страны Балтии, унаследовавшие ветхий постсоветский жилой фонд разработали свои механизмы работы с аварийным жильем. Безопасность человека, комфортная среда - общеевропейская ценность. Как эта ценность может воплощаться в жизни дома? А если это типовая "хрущевка"? Самый эффективный пример своевременной работы с ветхими домами смогла создать Литва. В то время как в России реновация больше звучит как снос и переселение граждан в другие окраинные районы, Литва за последние 10 лет починила больше 3000 хрущевок, Латвия - 1600, Эстония - 1100. Как они это делают? Как вместе работают муниципалитет, владелец жилья, и почему после ремонта коммунальные услуги стоят меньше в Литве? Откуда деньги на обновления тысяч ветхих убогих домов в скромной стране? Об этом рассказывает первый выпуск проекта "Европейские ценности".

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Голое влечение. Польша
programme.desc: Скандальный цикл передач, в которых люди находят потенциальных спутников жизни, обнаженные тела которых им показывают. Затем они должны будут сами раздеться и сделать выбор.

programme.title: Специальная военная чеченская
programme.desc: В январе 2025-го исполнилось тридцать лет со дня печально известного новогоднего штурма Грозного. В тактическом плане бои в столице мятежной Чечни для Кремля обернулись крупнейшим в новейшей военной истории провалом. В человеческом — десятками тысяч погибших, прежде всего, среди мирных жителей, которых, казалось бы, и \"освобождали\". Именно в те дни стало ясно: блицкриг, затеянный Москвой, превратился в затяжную войну. Первую чеченскую. Первую из больших войн, которые вела современная Россия. Внешние сходства между той \"спецоперацией\" и нынешней очевидны любому. Но что это: совпадения или закономерности? Можно ли утверждать, будто сегодняшние Россия и война в Украине — корнями из войны той, чеченской? И почему попытка силой изменить крохотную республику изменила в итоге самих россиян? Ключевые действующие лица эпохи рассказывают о принятии решений, которые и привели к войне.

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: Hosted by Erin Burnett, an expert in political science and economics, OutFront is an hour-long news programme examining the latest stories from the US and further afield. Broadcast live from either the New York studio or live on location from the site of a breaking story, the show features insightful opinions from informed guests. With expert analysis from CNN's correspondents and analysis from the show's panel, Erin Burnett OutFront dissects the stories of the day, leaving no stone unturned. Burnett, a former financial analyst for Goldman Sachs, uses her forthright approach to engage interviewees in honest discussion.

programme.title: Anderson Cooper 360
programme.desc: Anderson Cooper delves into the day's news, looking beyond the broadcast to give his take, prompting us to re-think what we hear in the headlines. Cooper has covered major, international stories like the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina on the Gulf Coast, the catastrophic BP oil spill and the 2010 earthquake in Haiti, which saw the whole world fall silent. The show has won an absolute plethora of awards over the years, including GLAAD Media and Emmy awards.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.desc: The citizens of Elmore are feeling down because it's January so Gumball and Anais invent a new holiday called Sluzzle Tag. / In Biology class Gumball and Darwin are waiting for a butterfly to emerge from its chrysalis. / After Gumball and Darwin have too much sugary cereal they begin thinking about the mysteries of the universe. / Gumball Darwin and Anais discover that Banana Joe's mom paints pictures which predict the future. / When Mr Small shows a health and safety video in class Darwin becomes obsessed with the idea of keeping the Wattersons safe. / Anais throws a party but no-one shows up as she has no friends or social skills. / Alan is so good-natured that Gumball feels compelled to make him lose his temper. / Things aren't going Gumball's way at school so he assumes there must be a Secret Society...

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Each member of the family thinks their demographic has it the toughest. Gumball and Darwin think guys have it the worst. Mom thinks women do. Anais thinks kids do. And Dad thinks that grown-ups do. They decide the only way to figure it out is to spend a day in each other's shoes, no matter if they're too-small, too-big, or high-heeled.

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Animated comedy following the adventures of Craig and his two friends Kelsey and JP as they explore the wilderness of the creek together. It is a chilly day at the Creek, and that means that Craig's mum must force him to wear his winter gear - not wanting to wear something that he finds constrictive, Craig slowly begins to remove every important article of clothing that is keeping him warm, but when it is time to go home for dinner, he must rush to find his winter gear before he freezes...

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Animated comedy following the adventures of Craig and his two friends Kelsey and JP as they explore the wilderness of the creek together. The Stump Kids imagine an alternate reality where they are not friends - in an alternate version of Itch to Explore, Craig is a member of the Junior Forest Scouts, Kelsey and a rat Mortimor are members of the Ninja Kids, and JP is with the Paintball Kids. Dissatisfied with their groups, they team up to explore some poison ivy in the centre of the Creek...

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Animated comedy following the adventures of Craig and his two friends Kelsey and JP as they explore the wilderness of the creek together. Elder Con comes to the Creek and the Stump Kids are excited - Craig befriends a fellow fan but ends up in a trivia battle with her over a cup, Kelsey sets up a booth and tries to sell her book but has trouble getting any customers, and JP tries to get into a screening room but encounters obstacles - when he finally enters, he discovers something unusual...

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Animated comedy following the adventures of Craig and his two friends Kelsey and JP as they explore the wilderness of the creek together. With winter over and spring beginning, Kelsey befriends a girl named Sun Chun who owns a hamster named Cookie and runs a giant hamster tunnel all over the Creek - when Craig and JP discover that Cookie has been killed by a cat, Sun Chun becomes inconsolable. Taking Kelsey's words literally, Sun then steals 100 hamsters in an effort to ease her misery...

programme.title: Total DramaRama

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Total DramaRama
programme.desc: Total DramaRama is canadian animated comedy series, spin-off of Total Drama, all characters are already well-known and loved by the audience. This time Duncan, Gwen, Courtney, Izzy, Noah, Bridgette and the rest find themselves in the past as kids and their adventures take place in kindergarten. The strict Chef Hatchet is there to keep his eye on them. programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The kids try to help Dad bond with Frankie. / When the uncomfortableness between them reaches new levels Gumball and Hot Dog Guy decide they have to confront their ongoing awkwardness by making things as awkward as possible. / The kids realise that they've never known their neighbour's name, and they're way past the window where they can ask. / Gumball has something uncomfortable to tell Penny but doesn't know how, until he makes a deal with Principal Brown. / Gumball and Anais go head to head in a leadership election voted for by their classmates. / Clayton realises he can imitate his classmates, and begins stealing the lives of the people of Elmore. / When unexpected couples in the world of Elmore start randomly falling in love, Gumball and Darwin have to figure out what's going on. / Gumball questions Mr Small's eco-friendly commitment, causing him to abandon society and live in the forest. Director: Mic Graves.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.desc: Telelavastuse tegevus toimub ühe vaikse Eesti linnakese vaiksel kõrvaltänaval. Vaikelu saab aga rikutud, kui Urmase ja Riina kõrvalmajja kolib Riina õde Rebekka koos oma uue mehe Raivoga. Saatuse tahtel naabriteks ja kälimeesteks saanud Urmas ja Raivo on inimestena erinevad ning nende õdedest elukaaslased omavahel nagistanud lapsest saadik. Lavastuses näeme, kuidas üleaedsed peavad lahendama igale eestlasele nii tuttavaid probleeme naabrite läbikäimises ning mismoodi aitavad sellele kaasa õdede ellu sekkuv ema ning Raivo hämaravõitu äripartner Viks. Ally ja Stephanie lähedasemaks saades hakkab ta mõistma tegelikke ohte, millega tema klient transseksuaalse prostituudina silmitsi seisab.

Kõik näib minevat hästi, kuid arved tahavad maksmist ja üür tasumist ning noortel hakkavad tekkima rahamured. Nii otsustavadki nad raha saamiseks teha pornofilmi. Kaamerate ees olles selgub, et neil on teineteise vastu rohkem tundeid kui nad arvata oleks osanud. Film ei sobi alaealistele.

programme.title: Adam Sandleri kaheksa hullu ööd

programme.title: Peeter Pikk-kõrv: jänes jooksus
programme.desc: Armastusväärne võrukael Peeter Pikk-kõrv jõuab järjefilmis taas kinolinale. Bea, Thomas ja jänesed on ajutise perekonna moodustanud, kuid vaatamata pingutustele ei suuda Peeter üleannetu jänku mainest vabaneda. Aiast välja sattudes leiab Peeter end maailmast, kus tema ulakusi hinnatakse. Kui aga pere teda otsima asudes kõigega riskib, peab Peeter selgusele jõudma, milline jänku ta olla tahab.

programme.title: Wild Child
programme.desc: Järjekordne pidu lõppeb skandaaliga ja isa saadab ärahellitatud tütre Poppy Inglismaale internaatkooli. Poppy peab põgenemisplaani, ent mõistab ajapikku, et ta ei soovigi lahkuda.

programme.title: Dicki ja Jane'i trikid
programme.desc: Hittkomöödia ootamatult rahahätta sattunud abielupaarist, kes otsustavad sulideks hakata. Dicki unistus täitub kui temast saab suurfirma asepresident. Õnn jääb paraku üürikeseks, sest juba järgmisel päeval tabab firmat krahh ja Dick lavastatakse selle peasüüdlaseks. Üleöö töötuks ja rahatuks jäänud Dick otsustab koos naise Janega kuritegevusele pühenduda ja firma kaabakast bossile (Alec Baldwin) kätte maksta…

programme.title: Kurjad linnud
programme.desc: Lennuvõimetute lindude saarele ilmuvad salapärased rohelised sead. Kolm vihast lindu otsustavad välja uurida, miks sead on sinna tulnud.

programme.title: Kujuta ette
programme.desc: Edukat finantsanalüütikut ärritab tütre käitumine, kes klammerdub oma lemmikpleedi ja kujutletavate sõbrannade külge. Kuid nende nõuanded tõotavad tulu tuua.

programme.title: Scott Pilgrim terve maailma vastu

programme.title: Superbad: ülikõva!

programme.title: Teismeline täiskasvanu

programme.title: Kuum pirukas: Klassikokkutulek
programme.desc: USA 2012 komöödia Lavastaja: Jon Hurwitz Osades: Jason Biggs, Alyson Hannigan, Chris Klein, Thomas Jan Nicholas, Tara Reid Kõik filmi "Kuum pirkukas" staarid naasevad gümnaasiumi kokkutulekule. Pika nädalavahetuse jooksul avastavad nad, kes on muutunud ja kes mitte, ning selgub, et aeg ja suured vahemaad ei suuda lõhkuda sõprussidemeid. See oli 1999. aasta kevadel, kui neli väikelinna Michigani poissi võtsid ette missiooni kaotamaks oma süütust. Nüüd on need eluaegsed sõbrad naasnud täiskasvanutena koju, et meenutada möödunud aegu.
